name: assay
description: Opens a page you changed, drives every control it offers, and reports what it did and what happened. One line every time, clean or not.

interface.shortDescription: Deterministic page QA that opens a page you changed, drives every control, and reports what happened in one line.
interface.longDescription: assay opens a web page you edited in a real browser, finds every control, uses all of them, and reports what it did and what happened in a single line whether the page is clean or broken. Deterministic, with no LLM, no API key, and no network.
